## 维护者速读
- 记录详情页的相关子表页签：去掉筛选、条件、选项、导出和单独的新建，右上角只留「在列表中打开」和「+ 添加」，空列表也有。
- 「+ 添加」按关系自动决定：普通关联打开选择框（第一行是新建）；主从子表有来源目录时选目录批量加行，没有时直接新建一行。一次选多条只发一个批量请求，全成或全不成，失败时显示服务器给的原因（指出是哪一条另有后续卡）。
- 子表的排序和列宽按每个用户、每张子表记住；从「在列表中打开」进去的列表页会显示来源记录的名字、面包屑、恢复按钮，新建也自动关联来源记录。另修了无币种时子表合计不显示的问题。
- 需要留意：普通关联的选择框会列出所有记录，选中一条已挂在别的记录下的，会直接把它改挂到当前记录，没有提示。
- 席位意见：通过，分区自己合并；合并前补一份认领范围说明；上面「改挂没有提示」请席位定是否加过滤，建议建后续卡处理。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · head `05a187d49b` · Part of #35601, Fixes #35710, Part of #35590 (maintainer direct dispatch, p2 allowed) · K=4 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · governed: no · +1192/−496, 23 files (1688 ≤ 3000) · CI 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 pending · 2026-11-20T04:35Z

Routing: no `packages/spec` / served-schema / REST face (`batch-routes.ts` untouched; the new `relatedLists` slice lives in the existing `sys_user_preference` row `ui.record.<object>`), `Clause-②: no`, not governed, under 3000 lines → **the area lands it** after R1.

Checked:
- Atomic add: `handleAddRecords` builds one operations list (junction `create` with `linkField`, else re-parent `update`) and makes ONE `ds.batchTransaction` call; on error it adds nothing, refreshes nothing and shows `body.error` / `message`. The console adapter (`data-objectstack` `batchTransaction`) never degrades to the sequential emulation when the backend declares the atomic capability, so on our server the pick is all or none. `addBatchable` hides the picker on a data source with no `batchTransaction`; the changeset says so. Ablation in the report (one call → per-op loop) goes red in 2 cases.
- Permission gate: `relatedNew` for a junction add, `relatedRowEdit` on the picked object for a re-parent, unchanged from the authored path; `pickerOffered` needs the grant AND the batch.
- `derivedAddOf` only when the page authored no `add` and no `schema`, on the enlarged face only: `lookup` → child picker; `master_detail` → the one required, visible, writable, single-valued `lookup` as catalog, else `undefined` (New). Multi-valued relations are excluded.
- Preferences: `sanitizeRelatedLists` keeps only a well-formed sort (`asc`/`desc`, non-empty field) and finite positive widths; the writer merges per list id before the provider's shallow merge, so one list's write keeps the others and `showEmptyFields`. Column writes fire on resize end (`data-table` `finalWidth`) and on drop, not per mousemove.
- Sourced list (`ObjectDataPage`): the source is the last `?from=` trail entry; `sourceRelationshipField` needs exactly one single-valued relation to the source's object, else nothing is drawn; the record name renders as a text node; the condition stays an ordinary removable URL filter; New under a source opens the form overlay with `link=<field>:<id>`.
- #35710: an unresolved-currency total is drawn as a plain amount from the same aggregate (ablation red in 1 case).
- Overlap: none of the 50 other open PRs touches `RelatedList.tsx`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`, `ObjectDataPage.tsx`, `RecordPickerDialog.tsx` or the two preference files; #35706/#35708 have closed.
- Part of: the failing-item naming (card item 5, acceptance line 2) is #35726, nested under #35601, so `Part of` is right.

Required before landing:
- **R1 (claim amendment, text only, no push).** Ten files are outside claim 7028356460's surface: `app-shell/src/context/RecordPreferencesProvider.tsx` + its `-25883` test, `react/src/context/RecordPagePreferencesContext.tsx`, `react/src/context/index.ts`, `app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx` + the new `sourceList-35601` test (the claim names `useOpenRecordList.ts` "and the list route's wiring"; name the file), `fields/src/widgets/RecordPickerDialog.tsx` (the claim's ⛔ is a column/search change; `createRow` is neither, but it is a new prop on a shared widget), `i18n/src/__tests__/residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx`, `plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`, `plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-blocks.nestedLabelsI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx`.

For the seat (not blocking):
- **S1.** The derived `lookup` picker has no `baseFilter`: it lists every child record, those already under this record (a pick is a no-op write) and those under another record (a pick moves it there, with no notice). It matches the card's 「勾选已有的」 and equals editing the lookup on the child's form, so it is not a defect, but it is now on every lookup related tab with no author opt-in. Recommendation: a follow-up card nested under #35601 that excludes rows already under this record and shows each row's current parent in the picker (or limits to unlinked rows). Seat to rule.

Nits (no action required):
- The removed chips' i18n keys stay in the packs unread (Acceptance notes); fold their removal into the next card that touches the packs.
- The breadcrumb's record name comes from the URL trail's `t`, so a hand-edited link can label the chip with any text; same trust as the existing record trail, rendered as text.

## 维护者速读
- 按席位的裁定补了一处：普通关联子表的「+ 添加」选择框现在只列出还没挂在任何记录下的记录。
- 已经挂在当前记录下的、挂在别的记录下的，都不会出现在选择框里，不会再被悄悄改挂。
- 要把一条记录从一个上级改到另一个上级，仍在那条记录自己的表单里改，改动看得见。
- 页面作者自己配置了筛选的选择框不受影响。
- 席位意见：通过，无需再改，分区可以合并。

## 席位核对
**delta ACCEPT** (on ACCEPT 7030529410) · head `e62ce9e74e` (one commit on `05a187d49b`) · Part of #35601, Fixes #35710 · K=5 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · governed: no · delta +33/−2, 2 files · CI 46 success, 15 skipped; the one cancelled `PR-body guards` run (04:38:21Z) is superseded by a success of the same check (04:39:07Z) · 2026-11-20T05:00Z

Routing unchanged: **the area lands it.**

- R1 (claim amendment naming the 10 files): posted on #35601, per ux-2. Closed.
- S1 (seat ruling): `derivedAddOf` for a `lookup` now returns `picker.filter = [{ field: <referenceField>, operator: 'is_empty' }]`, a spec `ViewFilterElement` that goes verbatim to `RecordPickerDialog`'s `baseFilter`; `is_empty` is the view operator that lowers to `$empty`, which reads `null` and `[]` alike. Only the derived path changes: an authored `add` returns before `derivedAddOf`, and the `addPickerFilter` suite is unchanged. The JSDoc names the ruling.
- Pin (`RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524`): the stand-in serves all three rows when the rule is absent and only the unlinked one when present; the case asserts the unlinked row present, the row here and the row under another parent absent, and every picker read carrying `["lead","is_empty"]`. Dropping the filter makes both absent rows appear, so the pin is not vacuous.

No required item. Land on this head.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [44678319894](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44678319894) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Dogfood Regression Gate (2/3)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44678319894/job/136095608999)** — 失败步骤: Boot example apps and exercise real user flows

  ```
  @objectstack/dogfood:test:  FAIL   isolated  test/colleague-lookup-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts > a member's agent finds a colleague through the read-only sys_user over MCP (ruling B) > ⭐ the query tool's
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/dogfood:test: AssertionError: expected 'Query records from an object with opt…' to contain 'sys_user'
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `test/colleague-lookup-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` — 24h 内已弹出 **3 个 PR**（#35670、#35682、#35725），但它们同属 **1 条投机栈** ⇒ **1 次独立命中**。汇总 issue：#35752（已刷新）
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 10 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
